fireside.speaker: Noah
fireside.text: "The granary wants food that WAITS — 1,538 of 2,000 kcal preserved. Smoke it, dry it, render it. The fresh stuff doesn't count."

fireside.speaker: Aroha
fireside.text: "Nobody's sleeping. The sky is waiting and nobody knows what to do with their hands."

fireside.speaker: Gerald
fireside.text: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"

fireside.speaker: Noah
fireside.text: "Did you see their faces? Too many angles. I keep wondering what they want from us."

tableLines.line: SYSTEM: Neural interface stable. Text overlay enabled.
💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Dmitri.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Skylar speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the southeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
🥣 Ben of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
Ben waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
🧳 A traveler swears The Red Table, southeast, is feasting — a whole elk, they say. (They're wrong. The Red Table is starving.)
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)

scaleLines.line: 🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (Highbeam Deer, Highbeam Deer, Night Court, Big Big, Highbeam Deer) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

🚨 Highbeam Deer, Highbeam Deer, Night Court, Big Big, Highbeam Deer is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.
📓 Codex: Highbeam Deer, Highbeam Deer, Night Court, Big Big, Highbeam Deer at the door, day 14.

📺 You brought down Night Court. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
